import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial, MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, smoothstep } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, CylinderGeometry, PlaneGeometry, Box3, Vector3, DirectionalLight, AmbientLight } = ctx.THREE;

  const mainGroup = new Group();
  const interactiveGroup = new Group();
  mainGroup.add(interactiveGroup);

  const disposables = [];
  const timelines = [];
  const primitiveInstances = [];

  // --- 1. STAGE BACKDROP WITH VERTICAL GRADIENT ---
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
  disposables.push(backdropGeo);

  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ depthWrite: false });
  const yUv = uv().y;
  const color0 = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063); // #0b0b10
  const color1 = vec3(0.063, 0.063, 0.09);  // #101017
  const color2 = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114); // #16161d
  const mix1 = mix(color0, color1, smoothstep(0.0, 0.55, yUv));
  const finalGradientColor = mix(mix1, color2, smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, yUv));
  backdropMat.colorNode = finalGradientColor;
  disposables.push(backdropMat);

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  mainGroup.add(backdropMesh);

  // --- 2. CONTACT SHADOW ---
  const shadowGeo = new PlaneGeometry(3.2, 3.2);
  disposables.push(shadowGeo);

  const shadowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
  const dist = uv().sub(0.5).length();
  const shadowOpacity = smoothstep(0.5, 0.0, dist).mul(0.55);
  shadowMat.colorNode = vec3(0.0).pack();
  shadowMat.opacityNode = shadowOpacity;
  disposables.push(shadowMat);

  const shadowMesh = new Mesh(shadowGeo, shadowMat);
  shadowMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  shadowMesh.position.set(0, -1.355, 0);
  interactiveGroup.add(shadowMesh);

  // --- 3. CYLINDRICAL PLINTH ---
  const plinthGeo = new CylinderGeometry(1.4, 1.4, 0.25, 64);
  disposables.push(plinthGeo);

  const plinthMat = new MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial({
    color: 0x14141a,
    roughness: 0.7,
    metalness: 0.3
  });
  disposables.push(plinthMat);

  const plinthMesh = new Mesh(plinthGeo, plinthMat);
  plinthMesh.position.set(0, -1.225, 0);
  interactiveGroup.add(plinthMesh);

  // --- 4. ACCENT RIM LIGHT & LOCAL LIGHTING ---
  const rimLight = new DirectionalLight('#ff2a38', 1.5);
  rimLight.position.set(-3, 0.5, 1);
  interactiveGroup.add(rimLight);

  const fillLight = new DirectionalLight('#e8ecf2', 0.8);
  fillLight.position.set(3, 2, 2);
  interactiveGroup.add(fillLight);

  // --- 5. HERO MESH LOADING & NORMALIZING ---
  const watchHolderGroup = new Group();
  interactiveGroup.add(watchHolderGroup);

  if (config.meshUrl) {
    ctx.glbLoader.loadGLB(config.meshUrl).then((gltf) => {
      const loadedScene = gltf.scene;

      // Compute bounding box to normalize to 2.2 units tall
      const box = new Box3().setFromObject(loadedScene);
      const size = new Vector3();
      box.getSize(size);
      const center = new Vector3();
      box.getCenter(center);

      const targetHeight = 2.2;
      const scaleFactor = targetHeight / size.y;
      loadedScene.scale.setScalar(scaleFactor);

      // Pivot adjustment: center watch of x/z, but rest its base (y.min) on top face of plinth (y = -1.1)
      const adjustedCenterY = center.y * scaleFactor;
      loadedScene.position.set(
        -center.x * scaleFactor,
        -adjustedCenterY,
        -center.z * scaleFactor
      );

      // Offset watch container so its base sits exactly at y = -1.1
      watchHolderGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0);

      // Redefine watch materials to match polished titanium look
      loadedScene.traverse((node) => {
        if (node.isMesh) {
          const originalMat = node.material;
          const watchMat = new MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial({
            color: '#e8ecf2',
            roughness: 0.52,
            metalness: 0.55,
            clearcoat: 0.2,
            clearcoatRoughness: 0.4,
            anisotropy: 0.8
          });
          if (originalMat && originalMat.map) {
            watchMat.map = originalMat.map;
          }
          node.material = watchMat;
          disposables.push(watchMat);
        }
      });

      watchHolderGroup.add(loadedScene);

      // Play soft entrance transform animation on mesh
      watchHolderGroup.position.y = -0.4;
      watchHolderGroup.scale.setScalar(0.95);
      gsap.to(watchHolderGroup.position, {
        y: 0,
        duration: 0.9,
        ease: 'power4.out',
        overwrite: 'auto'
      });
      gsap.to(watchHolderGroup.scale, {
        x: 1,
        y: 1,
        z: 1,
        duration: 0.95,
        ease: 'back.out(1.04)',
        overwrite: 'auto'
      });
    }).catch(err => console.error('Watch mesh loading fail:', err));
  }

  // --- 6. TEXT CONTENT LAYOUT ---
  const textGroup = new Group();
  mainGroup.add(textGroup);

  const headline = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('Calibre NA-01', {
    fontSize: 68,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'center'
  });
  headline.position.set(0, -1.6, 0.1);
  textGroup.add(headline);

  const body = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('Machined in-house. 41 mm. Grade 5 titanium.', {
    fontSize: 26,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'center'
  });
  body.position.set(0, -1.85, 0.1);
  textGroup.add(body);

  const caption = ctx.fontAtlas.createText('FROM 4200 USD / SHIPS IN 21 DAYS', {
    fontSize: 18,
    color: '#ff2a38',
    align: 'center'
  });
  caption.position.set(0, -2.1, 0.1);
  textGroup.add(caption);

  // --- 7. CINEMATIC PRIMITIVES APPLICATION ---
  if (ctx.primitives) {
    if (ctx.primitives['orbit']) {
      const p = ctx.primitives['orbit'](interactiveGroup, { speed: 0.15, radius: 0.6 });
      primitiveInstances.push(p);
    }
    if (ctx.primitives['depth-rotate']) {
      const p = ctx.primitives['depth-rotate'](interactiveGroup, { maxDeg: 6 });
      primitiveInstances.push(p);
    }
  }

  // --- 8. CLEANUP AND DISPOSAL ---
  mainGroup.userData.handlers = {};
  mainGroup.userData.cleanup = function() {
    timelines.forEach(tl => tl.kill());
    primitiveInstances.forEach(p => p.cleanup && p.cleanup());
    disposables.forEach(d => {
      if (d.dispose) d.dispose();
    });
  };

  return mainGroup;
}
